name: Connected Minimal-Non-Ample and Uniform-OM Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite binary class on its active coordinates.
statement: A conditioning-minimal non-ample class is connected exactly when it has at least three concepts, and these classes are exactly the non-free simple uniform-oriented-matroid tope classes.
proof: With at least three concepts, shortest paths inside ample conditionings handle non-antipodal pairs; a third concept splices two such paths for antipodal pairs, proving isometry and connectedness. The partial-cube recognition theorem then identifies the class with a non-free simple uniform-oriented-matroid tope set. The only two-concept minimal non-ample classes are ambient antipodal pairs on at least two coordinates and are disconnected.
